steps.en: Install the plugin into Claude Code from the marketplace
steps.zh: 从 marketplace 把插件装进 Claude Code

steps.en: Run the setup wizard — it detects which provider CLIs you have
steps.zh: 跑 setup 向导——它探测你装了哪些 provider CLI

steps.en: When one model's answer isn't enough, invoke an explicit multi-model workflow
steps.zh: 一个模型的意见不够时，显式启动多模型工作流

steps.en: Fans the task out to the detected providers with per-model attribution
steps.zh: 把任务扇给探测到的各家 provider，结果逐模型署名

steps.en: Claude synthesizes and applies the 75% consensus gate, surfacing disagreement
steps.zh: Claude 综合各家意见并套 75% 共识闸门，上报分歧

value.en: Blind-spot disagreements from rival AI vendors surface in the same session, before you merge — no copy-pasting between tools
value.zh: 来自其他厂商 AI 的盲点分歧，在合并之前就出现在同一个会话里——不用在工具之间来回粘贴
